slice: TC-32-BAD-AIR-TRIGGER-UNCHANGED: the two boundary cases evaluate the trigger at a fixed position instead of through physics frames
command: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run license-check && npm run sites:check && npm run devcontainer:check && npm run build && npm run dist:check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:parity && npm run pixi:visual-check && npm run interior:check && npx playwright test
workingTree: clean before the run and still clean after it
timestampProvenance: Both are `date -u` output printed around the run.
provenanceNote: The full run above is on 3335f19, the change on top of 44f2cda. It was then rebased onto f78aa90 (main after #204) as 5bd6690, with the same one-file change to src/diving-simulator-tests.html; on 5bd6690, tests/game.spec.js passed 3 of 3 and tests/baseline.spec.js 6 of 6 (rebasedChecks). The PR's CI runs the full verify on the rebased head.

results.distCheck: pass: 17 files scanned, no source maps, 4 diagnostic markers absent

cause: Case 4 set api.diverX = 103, exactly the pocket's x1, then ran two physics frames (runFrames(2, 0.033, 12)) before asserting. updateDiving() moves the diver horizontally, and a current rolled with the harness's unseeded Math.random (src/game-loop.js, once per dive below 5 m; the cave's chance is small but real) can drift the diver just left of x1, where the warning is correctly off. horizontalVelocity itself starts at 0 (resetDive) and nothing kicks. Observed on 2026-09-30: 2 failures in 9 runs on a branch whose only legacy change did not run in this case.
fix: Cases 4 and 5 (the edges) set the position and depth and call iframe.contentWindow.updateOverheadState(0). src/physics.js updateOverheadState() recomputes inOverhead (as every frame does), leaves silt visibility unchanged with dt 0, and sets badAirWarning from badAirAt(diverX) and depth, so the assertion now tests the trigger alone. Cases 1 to 3 still run through the frames. The test's ID and name, which docs/baseline/test-inventory.json lists, are unchanged.
repeatRuns: tests/game.spec.js: 6 of 6 passed on the change before the rebase, 3 of 3 after.

commentFollowUp.change: The test comment in src/diving-simulator-tests.html corrected (the drift comes from a rolled current; updateOverheadState also recomputes inOverhead); no code changed.
